verdict.rationale: Editor extensibility is a fair question for a game engine, but the evidence never documents a Bevy editor, let alone editor scripts or editor plugins; community comments only wish for one ('one thing that would sell this would be an editor like Godot has'). Engine plugins, the programmatic Scene system and the Bevy Remote Protocol are adjacent runtime building blocks, not editor extension, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can extend and automate the editor itself — custom tools, editor scripts, plugins that manipulate scenes and assets programmatically
